title: kate-fileio: decode and load (BOM, UTF-8, fallback encoding, EOL normalization)
summary: Bytes in, Rope out. Detection order: BOM, then strict UTF-8, then the configured fallback encoding via encoding_rs. CR LF and lone CR are normalized to LF and the original line ending is remembered for save. A pure `decode(&[u8])` function carries all the logic so tests need no filesystem; `load(path)` is a thin wrapper that adds size, mtime and a content digest.

lane.reason: Decoding is byte-level and platform independent. Fixtures are committed byte arrays. Reading a file in a tempdir behaves the same on Linux.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: New crate API. Dependencies to be added by this packet with justification: encoding_rs (legacy encodings; std has UTF-8 only), sha2 (digest), ropey (output type), tempfile (dev).

regression_tests.name: decode::tests::utf8_bom_is_stripped_and_remembered
regression_tests.asserts: Bytes EF BB BF 'hi' decode to text 'hi', bom == true, encoding UTF_8.

regression_tests.name: decode::tests::utf16le_bom_decodes
regression_tests.asserts: A UTF-16LE BOM followed by UTF-16LE 'héllo' decodes to 'héllo' with encoding UTF_16LE.

regression_tests.name: decode::tests::invalid_utf8_falls_back_to_configured_encoding
regression_tests.asserts: Byte 0xE9 alone decodes as 'é' under WINDOWS_1252 fallback, had_malformed false, encoding WINDOWS_1252.

regression_tests.name: decode::tests::crlf_normalized_and_majority_ending_recorded
regression_tests.asserts: For generated texts with mixed endings, the Rope contains no \r, the line count equals the number of logical lines, and line_ending is the majority ending.

regression_tests.name: load::tests::load_reads_tempdir_file_and_digests_it
regression_tests.asserts: A file written to tempfile::tempdir() loads with the right text, size and a SHA-256 equal to an independently computed digest.
